card.name: Inside "CNS depressant" phrases
card.fires_on: The word piece "depress" in "CNS depressant(s)" or "central nervous system depressants" in drug interaction text. It also fires weakly on a few other words, such as "need" in "don't need" and "further" before "reduce".

modes.label: CNS depress-ant
modes.description: The "depress" part of "depressant" right after CNS or central nervous system, in interaction warnings.
modes.example: If use with another CNS<< depress>>ant is unavoidable, consider dosage reduction.

modes.label: Stray other words
modes.description: Occasional single words in running text, such as "need" ending an idiom or "further" before a decrease.
modes.example: this is one more headache they don't<< need>>.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated to the pattern.
